name: Dem
description: Configuration of the Dem (Diagnostic Event Manager) module.

children.name: DemConfigSet
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters and sub containers of the Dem module supporting multiple configuration sets.

children.name: DemComponent
children.description: This container configures the monitored components and system dependencies.

children.name: DemComponentFailedCallbackFnc
children.description: Specifies the function to be called on component failed status changes.

children.name: DemComponentIgnoresPriority
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether the priority of events at this component shall be ignored.

children.name: DemImmediateChildComponentRef
children.description: Reference to all immediate children of the current component.

children.name: DemDTC
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for DemUdsDTC.

children.name: DemDTCFunctionalUnit
children.description: DTCFuncitonalUnit is a 1-byte value which identifies the corresponding basic vehicle / system function which reports the DTC. This parameter is necessary for the report of severity information.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this parameter is configured for no DTC, the Dem provides no DTC functional unit information.

children.name: DemDTCSeverity
children.description: DTC severity according to ISO 14229-1. This parameter depends on the automotive manufacturer.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If it is not configured, the value is counted as 'no severity'. If this parameter is configured for no DTC, the Dem provides no DTC severity information.
metadata.LITERALS: DEM_SEVERITY_CHECK_AT_NEXT_HALT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_SEVERITY_CHECK_IMMEDIATELY AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_SEVERITY_MAINTENANCE_ONLY AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_SEVERITY_NO_SEVERITY AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemDtcValue
children.description: Unique Diagnostic Trouble Code value for UDS

metadata.INTRODUCTION: (Range: 0x000000 and 0xFFFFFF are reserved for DTC groups by ISO 14229-1)

children.name: DemWWHOBDDTCClass
children.description: DTC Class according to ISO 14229-1 [2013 version]. This parameter depends on the automotive manufacturer.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If it is not configured, the value is marked as 'unclassified'. If this parameter is configured for no DTC, the Dem provides no DTC WWHOBD class information.
metadata.LITERALS: DEM_DTC_WWHOBD_CLASS_A AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_WWHOBD_CLASS_B1 AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_WWHOBD_CLASS_B2 AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_WWHOBD_CLASS_C AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_WWHOBD_CLASS_NOCLASS AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemDTCAttributesRef
children.description: This parameter defines the DTC Attributes associated with the DemDTC.

children.name: DemObdDTCRef
children.description: This parameter defines the OBD DTC configuration associated with the DemDTC.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: It is allowed to have events without a OBD DTC.

children.name: DemDTCAttributes
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for DemDTCAttributes.

children.name: DemAgingAllowed
children.description: Switch to allow aging/unlearning of the event or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: aging allowed false: aging not allowed

children.name: DemAgingCycleCounterThreshold
children.description: Number of aging cycles needed to unlearn/delete the event.

children.name: DemAgingCycleCounterThresholdForTFSLC
children.description: Number of aging cycles needed to reset the testFailedSinceLastClear Bit.

children.name: DemDTCPriority
children.description: Priority of the event/dtc, in view of full event buffer. A lower value means higher priority.

children.name: DemDTCSignificance
children.description: Significance of the event, which indicates additional information concerning fault classification and resolution.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: It can be mapped as Dem-internal data element. It shall be configured, if it is a part of event related data.

children.name: DemEventMemoryEntryFdcThresholdStorageValue
children.description: Threshold to allocate an event memory entry and to capture the Freeze Frame.

children.name: DemImmediateNvStorage
children.description: Switch to enable immediate storage triggering of an according event memory entriy persistently to NVRAM.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: immediate non-volatile storage triggering enabled false: immediate non-volatile storage triggering disabled

children.name: DemMaxNumberFreezeFrameRecords
children.description: This parameter defines the number of according freeze frame records, which can maximal be stored for this event. Therefore all these freeze frame records have the same freeze frame class.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter is only required for calculated record numeration (refer to DemTypeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumeration).

children.name: DemMemoryDestinationRef
children.description: The event destination assigns events to none, one or two origins. If no event destination is assigned to a specific event, the event is handled internally and is not visible externally to the Dcm. If more than one event destination is assigned to a specific event, the event can be present in the corresponding origins.

children.name: DemAgingCycleRef
children.description: Reference to the cycle which is triggering the aging of the event.

children.name: DemExtendedDataClassRef
children.description: This reference defines the link to an extended data class sampler.

children.name: DemFreezeFrameClassRef
children.description: These references define the links to a freeze frame class sampler.

children.name: DemFreezeFrameRecNumClassRef
children.description: This parameter defines the list of dedicated freeze frame record numbers associated with the diagnostic event. These record numbers are assigned to the freeze frame records (instead of calculated record numbers).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter is only required for configured record numeration (refer to DemTypeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumeration).

children.name: DemJ1939DTC_J1939NodeRef
children.description: Reference to a J1939 Node

children.name: DemJ1939ExpandedFreezeFrameClassRef
children.description: These references define the links to a J1939 freeze frame class sampler.

children.name: DemJ1939FreezeFrameClassRef
children.description: These references define the links to a J1939 freeze frame class sampler.

children.name: DemWWHOBDFreezeFrameClassRef
children.description: This reference defines the link to a WWH-OBD freeze frame class sampler.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterBasedClass
children.description: This container contains the configuration of Debounce Counter Based Class

children.name: DemDebounceBehavior
children.description: This parameter defines how the event debounce algorithm will behave, if a related enable condition is not fulfilled or ControlDTCSetting of the related event is disabled.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterDecrementStepSize
children.description: Defines the step size for decrementation of the internal debounce counter (PREPASSED).

children.name: DemDebounceCounterFailedThreshold
children.description: Defines the value of the internal debounce counter, which indicates the failed status.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterIncrementStepSize
children.description: Defines the step size for incrementation of the internal debounce counter (PREFAILED).

children.name: DemDebounceCounterJumpDown
children.description: Switch for the activation of Jump-Down.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Jump-Down activated false: Jump-Down deactivated

children.name: DemDebounceCounterJumpDownValue
children.description: Jump-Down value of the internal debounce counter which is taken as initialization value for the counter when the respective step-down occurs.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterJumpUp
children.description: Switch for the activation of Jump-Up.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Jump-Up activated false: Jump-Up deactivated

children.name: DemDebounceCounterJumpUpValue
children.description: Jump-Up value of the internal debounce counter which is taken as initialization value for the counter when the respective step-up occurs.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterPassedThreshold
children.description: Defines the value of the internal debounce counter, which indicates the passed status.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterStorage
children.description: Switch to store the debounce counter value non-volatile or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: debounce counter value shall be stored non-volatile false: debounce counter value is volatile

children.name: DemDebounceTimeBaseClass
children.description: This container contains the configuration of Debounce Counter Based Class

children.name: DemDebounceBehavior
children.description: This parameter defines how the event debounce algorithm will

metadata.INTRODUCTION: behave, if a related enable condition is not fulfilled or ControlDTCSetting of the related event is disabled.

children.name: DemDebounceTimeFailedThreshold
children.description: Defines the time out duration for "Event Failed" qualification.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The AUTOSAR configuration standard is to use SI units, so this parameter is defined as float value in seconds. Dem configuration tools must convert this float value to the appropriate value format for the use in the software implementation of Dem.

children.name: DemDebounceTimePassedThreshold
children.description: Defines the time out duration for "Event Passed" qualification.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The AUTOSAR configuration standard is to use SI units, so this parameter is defined as float value in seconds. Dem configuration tools must convert this float value to the appropriate value format for the use in the software implementation of Dem.

children.name: DemDtrs
children.description: This container holds the configuration of DTRs collection.

children.name: DemDtr
children.description: This container holds the configuration of one individual DTR.

children.name: DemDtrCompuDenominator0
children.description: Part of the conversion between the binary representation and the physical meaning analogous to the SW-C Template conversion CompuRationalCoeffs with 2 numerator coefficients and 1 denominator coefficient in the direction compuInternalToPhys.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This is the only one supported denominator value, a constant divisor. The value 0 is not allowed.

children.name: DemDtrCompuNumerator0
children.description: Part of the conversion between the binary representation and the physical meaning analogous to the SW-C Template conversion CompuRationalCoeffs with 2 numerator coefficients and 1 denominator coefficient in the direction compuInternalToPhys.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This is the first numerator value, which is multiplied with x^0, i.e., the offset.

children.name: DemDtrCompuNumerator1
children.description: Part of the conversion between the binary representation and the physical meaning analogous to the SW-C Template conversion CompuRationalCoeffs with 2 numerator coefficients and 1 denominator coefficient in the direction compuInternalToPhys.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This is the second numerator value, which is multiplied with x^1, i.e., the factor.

children.name: DemDtrId
children.description: The index identifier value assigned to this DTR. The value is generated during the Dem configuration process.

children.name: DemDtrMid
children.description: The OBDMID of the DTR.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The values 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, 0x60, 0x80, 0xA0, 0xC0, 0xE0 are reserved.

children.name: DemDtrTid
children.description: The OBDTID of the DTR.

children.name: DemDtrUasid
children.description: The UaSId the DTR data shall be scaled to, and reported together with the rescaled DTR data.

children.name: DemDtrUpdateKind
children.description: Update conditions applied by the Dem to reports of DTR values. Only supported if a related Event is configured. If no related Event is configured, the Dem behaves as if DemDtrUpdateKind is configured to "DEM_DTR_UPDATE_ALWAYS".

children.name: DemDtrEventRef
children.description: Reference to the DemEventParameter this DTR is related to. If the related event is not configured, the Dem cannot ensure consistency between the DTR and the event.

children.name: DemEventParameter
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for events.

children.name: DemComponentPriority
children.description: Specifies the priority within the component. A lower value means higher priority.

children.name: DemEventAvailable
children.description: This parameter configures an Event as unavailable.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: It is treated by Dem as if it does not exist. true = Event is available false = Event is not available

children.name: DemEventFailureCycleCounterThreshold
children.description: Defines the number of failure cycles for the event based fault confirmation.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this parameter is enabled, fault confirmation of the event is enabled accordingly.

children.name: DemEventId
children.description: Unique identifier of a diagnostic event.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter should not be changeable by user, because the Id should be generated by Dem itself to prevent gaps and multiple use of an Id. The events should be sequentially ordered beginning with 1 and no gaps in between.

children.name: DemEventKind
children.description: This parameter is used to distinguish between SW-C and BSW events. SW-C events are reported by Dem_SetEventStatus API and BSW events are reported by Dem_ReportErrorStatus API.

children.name: DemFFPrestorageSupported
children.description: If this parameter is set to true, then the Prestorage of FreezeFrames is supported by the assigned event. This parameter is useful to calculate the buffer size.

children.name: DemReportBehavior
children.description: Indicates the reporting behavior of the BSW Module (DemEventKind == DEM_EVENT_KIND_BSW) in order to determine the size of the reporting queue.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If the parameter is not defined it means REPORT_BEFORE_INIT.

children.name: DemComponentClassRef
children.description: Reference to the monitored component.

children.name: DemDTCRef
children.description: This parameter defines the DTC configuration (typically Uds) associated with the diagnostic event.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: It is allowed to have events without a DTC (e.g. for ECU-internal events triggering safety reactions without being reported via diagnostic communication). The same DemDTCAttributes can be used from several events, to combine these (refer to chapter "Combination of diagnostic event").

children.name: DemEnableConditionGroupRef
children.description: References an enable condition group.

children.name: DemOBDGroupingAssociativeEventsRef
children.description: This parameter defines a reference which points to a representative event of one group of associate events.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The "reverence event" must refer to it self. Note: One event is only allowed to be reverenced to only one group of associate events.

children.name: DemOperationCycleRef
children.description: Kind of operation cycle for the event (e.g. power cycle, driving cycle, ...)

children.name: DemStorageConditionGroupRef
children.description: References a storage condition group.

children.name: DemCallbackClearEventAllowed
children.description: The presence of this container indicates that the Dem has access to a "ClearEventAllowed" callback.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In case there is a DemCallbackClearEventAllowedFnc, this parameter defines the name of the function that the Dem will call. In case there is no DemCallbackClearEventAllowedFnc, the Dem will have an R-Port requiring the interface CallbackClearEventAllowed whose name is generated by using the unique callback-prefix followed by the event name.

children.name: DemCallbackClearEventAllowedFnc
children.description: Function name of prototype "ClearEventAllowed".

children.name: DemClearEventAllowedBehavior
children.description: Defines the resulting UDS status byte for the related event, which must not be cleared according to the ClearEventAllowed callback.

children.name: DemCallbackEventDataChanged
children.description: The presence of this container indicates that the Dem has access to an "EventDataChanged" callback.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In case there is a DemCallbackEventDataChangedFnc, this parameter defines the name of the function that the Dem will call. In case there is no DemCallbackEventDataChangedFnc, the Dem will have an R-Port requiring the interface CallbackEventDataChanged whose name is generated by using the unique callback-prefix followed by the event name.

children.name: DemCallbackEventDataChangedFnc
children.description: Function name of prototype "EventDataChanged"

children.name: DemCallbackEventStatusChanged
children.description: The presence of this container indicates, that the Dem has access to an "EventStatusChanged" callback, which the Dem will call to notify other components about the change in the status of an event.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In case there is a DemCallbackEvenStatusChangedFnc, this parameter defines the name of the function that the Dem will call. In case there is no DemCallbackEvenStatusChangedFnc, the Dem will have an R-Port requiring the interface CallbackEventStatusChanged, whose name is generated by using the unique callback-prefix followed by the event name.

children.name: DemCallbackEventStatusChangedFnc
children.description: Function name of prototype "EventStatusChanged"

children.name: DemCallbackInitMForE
children.description: The presence of this container indicates, that the Dem has access to an "InitMonitorForEvent" callback, which the Dem will call to initialize a monitor.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In case the container has a DemCallbackInitMForEFnc, this parameter defines the name of the function that the Dem will call. In case there is no DemCallbackInitMForEFnc, the Dem will have an R-Port requiring the interface CallbackInitMonitorForEvent, whose name is generated by using the unique callback-prefix followed by the event name.

children.name: DemCallbackInitMForEFnc
children.description: Function name of prototype "InitMonitorForEvent".

children.name: DemDebounceAlgorithmClass
children.description: Debounce algorithm class: counter based, time based, or monitor internal.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterBased
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for counter based debouncing.

children.name: DemDebounceCounterBasedClassRef
children.description: This reference selects the DemDebounceCounterBasedClass applied for the debouncing of the DemEventParameter.

children.name: DemDebounceMonitorInternal
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for monitor internal debouncing.

children.name: DemCallbackGetFDC
children.description: DemCallbackGetFDC specifies the callback (parameter DemCallbackGetFDCFnc is present) or R-Port (no parameter DemCallbackGetFDCFnc is present) to retrieve the fault detection counter value.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In case no container is configured, no fault detection counter will be available.

children.name: DemCallbackGetFDCFnc
children.description: This parameter defines the name of the function that the Dem will call to retrieve the fault-detection counter value from a complex driver.

children.name: DemDebounceTimeBase
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for time based debouncing.

children.name: DemDebounceTimeBaseRef
children.description: This reference selects the DemDebounceTimeBaseClass applied for the debouncing of the DemEventParameter.

children.name: DemIndicatorAttribute
children.description: This container contains the event specific configuration of Indicators.

children.name: DemIndicatorBehaviour
children.description: Behaviour of the linked indicator

metadata.LITERALS: DEM_INDICATOR_BLINKING AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_INDICATOR_BLINK_CONT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_INDICATOR_FAST_FLASH AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemIndicatorFailureCycleCounterThreshold
children.description: Defines the number of failure cycles for the WarningIndicatorOnCriteria.

children.name: DemIndicatorHealingCycleCounterThreshold
children.description: Defines the number of healing cycles for the WarningIndicatorOffCriteria.

children.name: DemIndicatorRef
children.description: Reference to the used indicator.

children.name: DemJ1939Node
children.description: Contains the parameters for the support of a logical J1939 node.

children.name: DemJ1939NmNodeRef
children.description: Reference to the corresponding J1939Nm node.

children.name: DemObdDTC
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for DemObdDTC.

children.name: DemConsiderPtoStatus
children.description: This parameter is TRUE, when the event is affected by the Dem PTO handling.

children.name: DemDtcValue
children.description: Unique Diagnostic Trouble Code value for OBD

children.name: DemEventOBDReadinessGroup
children.description: This parameter specifies the Event OBD Readiness group for PID $01 and PID $41 computation.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter is only applicable for emission-related ECUs.
metadata.LITERALS: DEM_OBD_RDY_AC AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_BOOSTPR AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_CAT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_CMPRCMPT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_EGSENS AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_ERG AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_EVAP AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_FLSYS AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_FLSYS_NONCONT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_HCCAT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_HTCAT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_MISF AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_NONE AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_NOXCAT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_O2SENS AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_O2SENSHT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_PMFLT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_RDY_SECAIR AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemJ1939DTCValue
children.description: Unique Diagnostic Trouble Code value for J1939 (consiting of SPN and FMI)

children.name: DemPidClass
children.description: This container contains the different PIDs for the single global OBD relevant freeze frame class. It is assembled out of one or several data elements.

children.name: DemPidIdentifier
children.description: identifier of the PID

children.name: DemPidDataElement
children.description: This container contains the different data elements contained in the specific PID.

children.name: DemPidDataElementClassRef
children.description: This reference contains the link to a data element class.

children.name: DemGeneral
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) of the BSW Dem

children.name: DemAgingCycleCounterProcessing
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether the aging counter is calculated Dem-internally or provided via Dem_SetAgingCycleCounterValue. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete, atp.StatusComment=This reference is set to obsolete and will be removed in release 4.3., atp.StatusRevisionBegin=4.2.2

children.name: DemAgingRequieresTestedCycle
children.description: Defines if the aging cycle counter is processed every aging cycles or if only tested aging cycle are considered.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: only tested aging cycle are considered for aging cycle counter false: aging cycle counter is processed every aging cycle

children.name: DemAvailabilitySupport
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether support for availability is enabled or not.

children.name: DemBswErrorBufferSize
children.description: Maximum number of elements in buffer for handling of BSW errors (ref. to SWS_Dem_00207).

children.name: DemClearDTCBehavior
children.description: Defines the clearing process of diagnostic information for volatile and non-volatile memory and the positive response handling for the Dcm module.

metadata.LITERALS: DEM_CLRRESP_NONVOLATILE_FINISH AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_CLRRESP_NONVOLATILE_TRIGGER AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_CLRRESP_VOLATILE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemClearDTCLimitation
children.description: Defines the supported Dem_<...>ClearDTC API scope.

children.name: DemDataElementDefaultEndianness
children.description: Defines the default endianness of the data belonging to a data element which is applicable if the DemExternalSRDataElementClass does not define a endianness.

metadata.LITERALS: BIG_ENDIAN AUTOSAR_ECUC LITTLE_ENDIAN AUTOSAR_ECUC OPAQUE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemDebounceCounterBasedSupport
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether support for counter based debouncing is enabled or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: counter based debouncing support is enabled false: counter based debouncing support is disabled

children.name: DemDebounceTimeBasedSupport
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether support for time based debouncing is enabled or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: time based debouncing support is enabled false: time based debouncing support is disabled

children.name: DemDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: * true: enabled (ON). * false: disabled (OFF).

children.name: DemDtcStatusAvailabilityMask
children.description: Mask for the supported DTC status bits by the Dem. This mask is used by UDS service 0x19.

children.name: DemEnvironmentDataCapture
children.description: DemEnvironmentDataCapture defines the point in time, when the data actually is captured.

children.name: DemEventCombinationSupport
children.description: This parameter defines the type of event combination supported by the Dem.

metadata.LITERALS: DEM_EVCOMB_DISABLED AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_EVCOMB_ONRETRIEVAL AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_EVCOMB_ONSTORAGE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemEventDisplacementStrategy
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether support for event displacement is enabled or not, and which displacement strategy is followed.

metadata.LITERALS: DEM_DISPLACEMENT_FULL AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DISPLACEMENT_NONE AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DISPLACEMENT_PRIO_OCC AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemEventMemoryEntryStorageTrigger
children.description: Configures the primary trigger to allocate an event memory entry.

metadata.LITERALS: DEM_TRIGGER_ON_CONFIRMED AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_TRIGGER_ON_FDC_THRESHOLD AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_TRIGGER_ON_PENDING AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_TRIGGER_ON_TEST_FAILED AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemGeneralInterfaceSupport
children.description: The interfaces GeneralEvtInfo, GeneralCallbackEventDataChanged and GeneralCallbackEventStatusChange are provided if DemGeneralInterfaceSupport is equal to true.

children.name: DemHeaderFileInclusion
children.description: Name of the header file(s) to be included by the Dem module containing the used C-callback declarations.

children.name: DemImmediateNvStorageLimit
children.description: This parameter defines the maximum number of occurrences, a specific event memory entry is allowed, to be stored in NVRAM immediately (refer to DemImmediateNvStorage).

children.name: DemMaxNumberEventEntryEventBuffer
children.description: Specifies the size of the buffer for storing environmental data (freezeframes and extended data) until they are processed and stored to the event memory.

children.name: DemMaxNumberEventEntryPermanent
children.description: Maximum number of events which can be stored in the permanent memory.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The assignment of an event to this memory type is dynamic and used for emission-related events only.

children.name: DemMaxNumberPrestoredFF
children.description: Defines the maximum number for prestored freeze frames.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If set to 0, then freeze frame prestorage is not supported by the ECU.

children.name: DemOBDSupport
children.description: This configuration switch defines OBD support and kind of OBD ECU.

metadata.LITERALS: DEM_OBD_DEP_SEC_ECU AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_MASTER_ECU AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_NO_OBD_SUPPORT AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_OBD_PRIMARY_ECU AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemOccurrenceCounterProcessing
children.description: This configuration switch defines the consideration of the fault confirmation process for the occurrence counter. For OBD and mixed systems (OBD/non OBD, refer to DemOBDSupport) configuration switch shall always set to DEM_PROCESS_OCCCTR_TF.

children.name: DemOperationCycleStatusStorage
children.description: Defines if the operation cycle state is available over the power cycle (stored non-volatile) or not.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: the operation cycle state is stored non-volatile false: the operation cycle state is only stored volatile

children.name: DemPTOSupport
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether PTO support (and therefore PID $1E support) is enabled or not.

children.name: DemResetConfirmedBitOnOverflow
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether the confirmed bit is reset or not while an event memory entry will be displaced.

children.name: DemStatusBitHandlingTestFailedSinceLastClear
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether the aging and displacement mechanism shall be applied to the "TestFailedSinceLastClear" status bits.

children.name: DemStatusBitStorageTestFailed
children.description: Activate/Deactivate the permanent storage of the "TestFailed" status bits.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: storage activated false: storage deactivated

children.name: DemSuppressionSupport
children.description: This configuration switch defines, whether support for suppression is enabled or not.

children.name: DemTaskTime
children.description: Allow to configure the time for the periodic cyclic task. Please note: This configuration value shall be equal to the value in the Basic Software Scheduler configuration of the RTE module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The AUTOSAR configuration standard is to use SI units, so this parameter is defined as float value in seconds. Dem configuration tools must convert this float value to the appropriate value format for the use in the software implementation of Dem. min: A negative value is not allowed. max: After event status was reported, processing shall be completed within 100ms in order to have the fault entry status information updated as soon as possible (e.g. for PID $01). upperMultiplicity: Exactly one TaskTime must be specified per configuration. lowerMultiplicity: Exactly one TaskTime must be specified per configuration.

children.name: DemTriggerDcmReports
children.description: Activate/Deactivate the notification to the Diagnostic Communication Manager for ROE processing.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Dcm ROE notification activated false: Dcm ROE notification deactivated

children.name: DemTriggerDltReports
children.description: Activate/Deactivate the notification to the Diagnostic Log and Trace.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: Dlt notification activated false: Dlt notification deactivated

children.name: DemTriggerFiMReports
children.description: Activate/Deactivate the notification to the Function Inhibition Manager.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: FiM notification activated false: FiM notification deactivated

children.name: DemTriggerMonitorInitBeforeClearOk
children.description: Defines if the monitor re-initialization has to be triggered before or after the Dem module returns DEM_CLEAR_OK.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: trigger re-initialization before DEM_CLEAR_OK false: trigger re-initialization after DEM_CLEAR_OK

children.name: DemTypeOfDTCSupported
children.description: This parameter defines the format returned by Dem_DcmGetTranslationType and does not relate to/influence the supported Dem functionality.

metadata.LITERALS: DEM_DTC_TRANSLATION_ISO11992_4 AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_TRANSLATION_ISO14229_1 AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_TRANSLATION_ISO15031_6 AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_TRANSLATION_SAEJ1939_73 AUTOSAR_ECUC DEM_DTC_TRANSLATION_SAE_J2012_DA_DTCFORMAT_04 AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: DemTypeOfFreezeFrameRecordNumeration
children.description: This parameter defines the type of assigning freeze frame record numbers for event-specific freeze frame records.

children.name: DemVersionInfoApi
children.description: Activate/Deactivate the version information API.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: true: version information activated false: version information deactivated

children.name: DemMILIndicatorRef
children.description: This parameter defines the indicator representing the MIL.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: This parameter is mandatory for ECUs supporting OBD (refer to DemOBDSupport).

children.name: DemCallbackDTCStatusChanged

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In case there is a DemCallbackDTCStatusChangedFnc, this parameter defines the name of the function that the Dem will call. In case there is no DemCallbackDTCStatusChangedFnc, the Dem will have an R-Port requiring the interface CallbackDTCStatusChanged whose name is generated by using the unique callback-prefix followed by the event name. Status change notifications are supported for DTCs in primary memory only.

children.name: DemCallbackDTCStatusChangedFnc
children.description: Function name of prototype "DTCStatusChanged".

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Note: If the parameter DemTriggerDcmReports is enabled, this parameter shall not be "Dcm_DemTriggerOnDTCStatus".

children.name: DemDataElementClass

children.name: DemExternalCSDataElementClass
children.description: This container contains the configuration (parameters) for an external client/server based data element class.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: It defines, how the Dem can obtain the value of the data element from either a SW-C or another BSW module. Whether a client/server port or a C function-call is used, is defined by DemDataElementUsePort.

children.name: DemDataElementDataSize

children.description: In case of DemDataElementUsePort is false, this parameter defines the prototype of the C function "ReadDataElement" used to get the according value.

children.name: DemDataElementUsePort
children.description: If the parameter is set to True, a R-Port is generated, to obtain the data element (interface DataServices_{Data}).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If the parameter is set to False, the information is obtained by C function-call on another BSW module specified by the parameter DemDataElementReadFnc.

children.name: DemExternalSRDataElementClass

children.name: DemDataElementDataSize
children.description: Defines the size of the data element in bits.

children.name: DemDataElementDataType

children.description: Instance Reference to the primitve sub-element (at any level) of composite data in a port which shall be read or written.
